categories.main_business_segments: The company specializes in the research, development, and manufacturing of honeycomb ceramic products primarily used for air pollution control. Its main products include honeycomb ceramic carriers for vehicle exhaust after-treatment systems such as DOC, SCR, ASC, TWC, DPF, ACT-DPF, SiC-DPF, and GPF, as well as energy-saving regenerative bodies for industrial applications. It also operates subsidiaries focusing on environmental protection equipment, precision manufacturing, and emerging energy technologies like hydrogen energy and thermoacoustic refrigeration.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company has proprietary core technologies including the synthesis and crystallization control of cordierite materials and high-performance honeycomb ceramic carrier preparation processes. It integrates formula design, precision mold manufacturing, and kiln firing process control to produce low thermal expansion, thin-walled, high-porosity ceramic carriers. Advanced manufacturing involves multi-step extrusion, drying, and firing with precise temperature control to ensure product quality and performance. The company also develops silicon carbide-based DPFs and ultra-high porosity ceramics for emerging applications.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Primary customers are catalyst coating manufacturers serving heavy-duty diesel trucks, non-road mobile machinery, and marine engine manufacturers. The company serves domestic and international markets, including the US, Canada, South Korea, and India. It targets OEMs and aftermarket sectors for vehicle emission control systems, focusing on heavy trucks and expanding into passenger vehicles. The company also supplies energy-saving components for industrial applications and is developing products for hydrogen energy and thermoacoustic refrigeration markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates mainly in China with production bases in Shandong, Chongqing, Anhui, and Jiangxi provinces. It has established overseas sales and service networks covering North America, Europe, and Asia, including the US, Canada, South Korea, and India. The company exports honeycomb ceramic carriers and DPF products internationally and maintains strategic partnerships with global customers. Its geographic footprint supports both domestic heavy-duty vehicle markets and growing international demand for emission control products.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates primarily in the midstream segment of the supply chain, focusing on the manufacturing of core ceramic substrates used in vehicle exhaust after-treatment systems. It procures raw materials like talc, kaolin, alumina, and cellulose, processes them into honeycomb ceramic carriers, and supplies these to catalyst coating companies and system integrators downstream. It also engages in R&D and production of related environmental protection equipment and emerging energy technology components.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include advancing emission control technologies to meet evolving national and international vehicle emission standards such as China VI and Euro 7. The company invests in R&D for ultra-low NOx emission carriers, thin-walled and high-porosity ceramics, and silicon carbide DPFs. It is expanding into emerging fields like hydrogen energy fuel cell reformers and thermoacoustic refrigeration systems. The company emphasizes innovation in materials science, manufacturing processes, and product diversification to enhance competitiveness and support sustainable growth.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through direct sales of honeycomb ceramic carriers and related environmental protection products to domestic and international customers. The company employs a direct sales model with both domestic and export sales, including Vendor Managed Inventory (VMI) arrangements for overseas customers. Revenue recognition occurs upon transfer of control, either at product shipment, customer acceptance, or inventory drawdown in VMI warehouses. Additional income sources include government subsidies, investment income, and service fees.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is a leading domestic manufacturer of honeycomb ceramic carriers, especially for large-size carriers used in heavy-duty diesel vehicles. It competes against global oligopolies dominated by Corning (USA) and NGK (Japan), which hold over 90% of the global market. The company has broken domestic reliance on foreign suppliers by achieving technological breakthroughs and scale production. It holds multiple patents and national awards, positioning itself as a key player in China's emission control materials industry with growing international market presence.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported operating revenue of approximately RMB 284 million, a 14.46% decrease from the previous year, and a net loss attributable to shareholders of about RMB 44 million, indicating an expanded loss. Total assets stood at approximately RMB 1.19 billion, down 19.57% year-over-year. The company’s R&D investment accounted for 7.71% of revenue, reflecting a strategic focus on innovation despite reduced spending. Cash flow from operations improved significantly to RMB 102 million. The company is in a growth and transformation phase, facing market challenges but investing in new technologies and markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its proprietary cordierite material synthesis and precise manufacturing processes that yield honeycomb ceramic carriers with ultra-low thermal expansion, high porosity, and thin walls, meeting stringent emission standards. Its products support near-zero emission diesel vehicles and advanced after-treatment systems, providing durability and performance under harsh thermal conditions. The company differentiates through integrated formula-mold-kiln technology, extensive patent portfolio, and ability to produce large-size carriers domestically, reducing reliance on foreign suppliers. It also leverages innovation to expand into emerging energy sectors, enhancing its competitive edge.
